items.title: From neural development to regenerative medicine: A research journey in stem cell biology, spinal cord repair, and iPSC-based drug discovery.
items.summary: This commemorative article reflects on a research journey spanning neural development, stem cell biology, regenerative medicine, and iPSC-based drug discovery. My early work focused on RNA-mediated regulation in the nervous system, including studies on myelin basic protein gene regulation and the identification and functional characterization of the RNA-binding protein Musashi. These studies contributed to the conceptual foundation of neural stem cell biology and helped establish methods for identifying and isolating neural stem/progenitor cells, including those present in the adult human brain. Building on this foundation, my colleagues and I pursued translational research in spinal cord injury, ranging from analyses of injury pathophysiology and molecular interventions to preclinical studies using rodent and non-human primate models. These efforts ultimately led to the first-in-human clinical study of induced pluripotent stem cell-derived neural stem/progenitor cell transplantation for subacute spinal cord injury. In parallel, we developed patient-derived iPSC platforms for neurological disease modeling and drug discovery, particularly for amyotrophic lateral sclerosis, where iPSC-based screening identified Ropinirole as a therapeutic candidate and enabled reverse translational research linking cellular phenotypes with clinical responses. Looking ahead, I argue that the future of regenerative therapy will depend on the continued integration of developmental biology, stem cell science, disease modeling, rehabilitation, and clinical translation to address unmet medical needs in disorders of the central nervous system.
items.titleZh: 从神经发育到再生医学：干细胞生物学、脊髓修复和基于iPSC的药物发现研究之旅
items.summaryZh: 本文是作者研究生涯的回顾性综述，总结了其在神经干细胞生物学、脊髓损伤修复和iPSC药物发现方面的贡献。关键内容包括：发现RNA结合蛋白Musashi在神经干细胞中的作用；开发了基于iPSC的ALS疾病模型，并通过筛选发现Ropinirole作为潜在治疗药物；推动了iPSC来源神经干细胞移植治疗脊髓损伤的首次人体临床试验。文章强调未来再生医学需要多学科整合。
items.insight: 这篇综述由该领域资深研究者撰写，系统总结了从基础神经发育研究到iPSC药物发现的完整转化路径，特别是Ropinirole的发现过程，为ALS研究者提供了药物筛选和反向转化研究的范例，值得关注其方法学和临床转化经验。

aiRead.keyFinding: iPSC筛选发现Ropinirole作为ALS治疗候选药物，并已进入临床试验阶段
aiRead.limitation: 作为综述文章，未提供新的实验数据，且Ropinirole的疗效尚未在临床试验中证实
aiRead.watchNext: 关注Ropinirole在ALS临床试验中的结果，以及iPSC技术在更多神经退行性疾病中的应用

items.abstractZh: 这篇纪念性文章回顾了涵盖神经发育、干细胞生物学、再生医学和基于iPSC的药物发现的研究历程。早期工作聚焦于神经系统中RNA介导的调控，包括髓鞘碱性蛋白基因调控的研究，以及RNA结合蛋白Musashi的鉴定和功能表征。这些研究为神经干细胞生物学的概念基础做出了贡献，并帮助建立了识别和分离神经干/祖细胞（包括成人脑中的细胞）的方法。在此基础上，作者及其同事开展了脊髓损伤的转化研究，从损伤病理生理学分析和分子干预，到使用啮齿动物和非人灵长类模型的临床前研究。这些努力最终导致了诱导多能干细胞来源的神经干/祖细胞移植治疗亚急性脊髓损伤的首次人体临床研究。与此同时，他们开发了患者来源的iPSC平台，用于神经系统疾病建模和药物发现，特别是在肌萎缩侧索硬化症中，基于iPSC的筛选确定了Ropinirole作为治疗候选药物，并实现了将细胞表型与临床反应联系起来的反向转化研究。展望未来，作者认为再生治疗的未来将依赖于发育生物学、干细胞科学、疾病建模、康复和临床转化的持续整合，以解决中枢神经系统疾病中未满足的医疗需求。
items.frontierRationale: 该文章发表于2026年，总结了iPSC技术在ALS药物发现中的最新应用，并涉及首次人体临床试验，具有明确的转化价值和新近性。

items.title: Sex-associated differences in routine inflammatory markers and neuromuscular ultrasound measurements in amyotrophic lateral sclerosis: a retrospective cross-sectional study.
items.summary: Amyotrophic lateral sclerosis (ALS) is a progressive neurodegenerative disorder with substantial clinical heterogeneity. Systemic inflammatory markers and neuromuscular ultrasound measurements have both been studied in ALS, but their sex-associated differences within ALS cohorts remain incompletely characterized. To examine sex-associated differences in routine inflammatory markers and neuromuscular ultrasound measurements in patients with ALS, and to determine whether these differences persisted after adjustment for available clinical and anthropometric variables. In this retrospective cross-sectional study, 135 patients with ALS were included. Routine inflammatory markers, including neutrophils, monocytes, lymphocytes, platelets, and erythrocyte sedimentation rate (ESR), were analyzed alongside quantitative neuromuscular ultrasound measurements. Between-sex comparisons were performed, and false discovery rate correction was applied to account for multiple testing. Multivariable linear regression analyses were performed with adjustment for age, disease duration, body mass index (BMI), ALSFRS-R total score, FVC% predicted, smoking status, hypertension, and diabetes. Female patients showed lower ALSFRS-R total scores and higher estimated progression rates in unadjusted comparisons, whereas pulmonary function variables did not differ significantly between sexes. After FDR correction, estimated progression rate, neutrophil count, monocyte count, ESR, and masseter muscle thickness remained significantly different between sexes, while the ALSFRS-R difference was borderline significant. In fully adjusted models, female sex was associated with lower neutrophil count, monocyte count, and median nerve cross-sectional area; biceps brachii thickness showed a less stable association after sensitivity analysis. An exploratory secondary analysis showed lower rectus femoris cross-sectional area during thigh-lift in female patients after full adjustment. In the spline sensitivity analysis, this association remained statistically significant but was interpreted cautiously because it was not present in the earlier adjustment models. Selected routine inflammatory markers and neuromuscular ultrasound measurements differed between male and female patients within this ALS cohort. These findings support consideration of sex and anthropometric context, including body size, when interpreting inflammatory markers and ultrasound-based structural measurements. In the absence of healthy controls, the observed ultrasound differences cannot be attributed specifically to ALS-related biology. Studies with healthy controls, longitudinal functional outcomes, body-composition assessment, and independent multicenter cohorts are needed to clarify the disease-specific and prognostic relevance of these observations.
items.titleZh: 肌萎缩侧索硬化症中常规炎症标志物与神经肌肉超声测量的性别相关差异：一项回顾性横断面研究
items.summaryZh: 这项回顾性研究分析了135名ALS患者的常规炎症指标和神经肌肉超声数据，发现女性患者的中性粒细胞、单核细胞计数和ESR更低，咬肌厚度及正中神经横截面积也存在性别差异。研究提示，在解读ALS患者的炎症标志物和超声测量结果时，应结合性别和体型等人体测量背景。
items.insight: 该研究系统性地揭示了ALS患者中炎症标志物和神经肌肉超声测量的性别差异，提示性别和体型是解读这些指标时不可忽视的混杂因素，对设计性别敏感的ALS生物标志物研究和临床试验分层具有直接参考价值。

aiRead.keyFinding: 在ALS队列中，女性患者的中性粒细胞、单核细胞计数、ESR及正中神经横截面积显著低于男性，且部分差异在调整临床和人体测量变量后仍存在。
aiRead.limitation: 缺乏健康对照组，无法将观察到的超声差异明确归因于ALS相关病理；且为单中心回顾性设计，样本量有限。
aiRead.watchNext: 后续应关注包含健康对照、纵向功能结局和身体成分评估的多中心前瞻性研究，以验证这些性别差异的疾病特异性和预后价值。

items.abstractZh: 肌萎缩侧索硬化症（ALS）是一种具有显著临床异质性的进行性神经退行性疾病。全身性炎症标志物和神经肌肉超声测量均已在ALS中有所研究，但ALS队列中这些指标的性别相关差异尚未被充分表征。本研究旨在检查ALS患者常规炎症标志物和神经肌肉超声测量的性别相关差异，并确定这些差异在调整可用的临床和人体测量变量后是否仍然存在。这项回顾性横断面研究纳入了135名ALS患者。分析了包括中性粒细胞、单核细胞、淋巴细胞、血小板和红细胞沉降率（ESR）在内的常规炎症标志物，以及定量神经肌肉超声测量。进行了性别间比较，并应用错误发现率（FDR）校正以处理多重检验。多变量线性回归分析调整了年龄、病程、体重指数（BMI）、ALSFRS-R总分、FVC%预计值、吸烟状况、高血压和糖尿病。在未调整的比较中，女性患者的ALSFRS-R总分较低，估计进展率较高，而肺功能变量在性别间无显著差异。经FDR校正后，估计进展率、中性粒细胞计数、单核细胞计数、ESR和咬肌厚度在性别间仍存在显著差异，而ALSFRS-R差异为临界显著。在完全调整的模型中，女性性别与较低的中性粒细胞计数、单核细胞计数和正中神经横截面积相关；肱二头肌厚度在敏感性分析后关联性不稳定。一项探索性二次分析显示，在完全调整后，女性患者抬腿时股直肌横截面积较低。在样条敏感性分析中，该关联仍具有统计学显著性，但因未在早期调整模型中出现而被谨慎解读。在该ALS队列中，选定的常规炎症标志物和神经肌肉超声测量在男性和女性患者间存在差异。这些发现支持在解读炎症标志物和超声结构测量时考虑性别和人体测量背景（包括体型）。由于缺乏健康对照，观察到的超声差异不能具体归因于ALS相关生物学。需要包含健康对照、纵向功能结局、身体成分评估和独立多中心队列的研究来阐明这些观察结果的疾病特异性和预后相关性。
items.frontierRationale: 该研究基于2026年发表的近期临床队列数据，聚焦ALS临床异质性中的性别维度，为炎症标志物和超声测量的个体化解读提供了直接的转化参考。

items.title: Tofersen Treatment in SOD1 -ALS: Real-World Evidence from a Retrospective Multicenter Study in France (FORSLA Study).
items.summary: To evaluate the effectiveness of Tofersen in patients with superoxide dismutase 1 gene ( SOD1-ALS ) patients in France in a real-world setting, using disease progression within patient comparisons and with a historical cohort. Patients with SOD1 -ALS were included from across 19 French FILSLAN network centers. Baseline was defined as the treatment initiation date. Main endpoints were the ALSFRS-R progression rate and plasmatic neurofilament light chain (NfL) levels at baseline and 12 months after baseline. In the Tofersen Cohort (N=46), within-group comparisons showed that the mean ALS functional rating scale revised (ALSFRS-R) progression rate slowed from 0.53 ± 0.5 at baseline to 0.22 ± 0.3 point/month at 12 months ( P =.006). NfL levels significantly decreased from 89.0 ± 9.0 pg/ml at baseline to 29.2 ± 19.5.5 at 12 months ( P =.004). Exploratory comparisons with a propensity score (PS) matched historical cohort (39 matched pairs) using a mixed-effects model, ALSFRS-R progression rate at baseline, 6 months, and 12 months after baseline, showed no statistically significant differences between groups P =.30, whereas longitudinal ALSFRS-R scores differed significantly between groups (time-treatment interaction P =.006). The mean survival of the PS matched population was longer in the Tofersen Cohort (42.6 months) than the Historical Cohort (31.8 months) P =.004. Time-dependent adjusted cox analysis showed that Tofersen was associated with a reduction in mortality risk (adjusted HR=0.34; 95% CI, 0.12-0.91; P =.03). Tofersen seems to be associated with slower functional decline and reduced NfL levels. While limitations of retrospective design and ALSFRS-R sensitivity must be acknowledged, these findings provide real-world evidence suggesting a clinical benefit of Tofersen.
items.titleZh: Tofersen治疗SOD1-ALS：法国多中心回顾性研究的真实世界证据（FORSLA研究）
items.summaryZh: 法国19个中心46名SOD1-ALS患者接受Tofersen治疗的真实世界数据显示，治疗12个月后，患者功能衰退速度（ALSFRS-R进展率）较基线显著减缓，血液NfL水平显著下降。与历史对照相比，Tofersen组生存期更长，死亡风险降低约66%。研究为观察性回顾性设计，存在固有局限性。
items.insight: 该研究是Tofersen在SOD1-ALS中规模较大的真实世界证据之一，其患者内前后对照设计部分弥补了缺乏随机对照的不足，且生存期获益信号值得关注，为这种靶向ASO疗法在临床实践中的价值提供了重要参考。

items.abstractZh: 本研究旨在评估Tofersen在法国真实世界环境中对超氧化物歧化酶1基因（SOD1-ALS）患者的疗效，采用患者内疾病进展比较及与历史队列的比较方法。研究纳入了来自法国19个FILSLAN网络中心的SOD1-ALS患者。基线定义为治疗开始日期。主要终点为基线和基线后12个月的ALSFRS-R进展率和血浆神经丝轻链（NfL）水平。在Tofersen队列（N=46）中，组内比较显示，平均ALS功能评定量表修订版（ALSFRS-R）进展率从基线的0.53 ± 0.5点/月减缓至12个月时的0.22 ± 0.3点/月（P = .006）。NfL水平从基线的89.0 ± 9.0 pg/ml显著下降至12个月时的29.2 ± 19.5 pg/ml（P = .004）。与倾向评分（PS）匹配的历史队列（39对匹配）进行的探索性比较（使用混合效应模型）显示，基线、6个月和12个月后的ALSFRS-R进展率组间无统计学显著差异（P = .30），而纵向ALSFRS-R评分组间差异显著（时间-治疗交互作用P = .006）。PS匹配人群的平均生存期在Tofersen队列（42.6个月）长于历史队列（31.8个月）（P = .004）。时间依赖性校正Cox分析显示，Tofersen与死亡风险降低相关（校正HR=0.34；95% CI，0.12-0.91；P = .03）。Tofersen似乎与较慢的功能衰退和NfL水平降低相关。尽管必须承认回顾性设计和ALSFRS-R敏感性的局限性，但这些发现提供了提示Tofersen临床获益的真实世界证据。
items.frontierRationale: 该研究提供了Tofersen在真实世界SOD1-ALS患者中近期（2026年发表）的疗效和生存获益证据，具有直接的ALS转化价值。

items.title: Macrophage responses to and elevated antibody levels against Chlorovirus ATCV-1 in ALS patients.
items.summary: Acanthocystis turfacea chlorella virus 1 (ATCV-1) is a giant virus that is part of the human oral microvirome. Previously we showed that ATCV-1 infects mouse macrophages, stimulates production of inflammatory cytokines, and accelerates motor neuron disease in the Amyotrophic Lateral Sclerosis (ALS) model SOD1-G93A transgenic mice. This, coupled with significantly elevated levels of serum IgG1 antibody to ATCV-1 in ALS patients compared with healthy controls, suggests involvement of ATCV-1 in ALS. Herein, using serum and CSF from a different ALS cohort we again show elevated antibodies to ATCV-1 in ALS patients compared with healthy controls. To assess ATCV-1 in human macrophages, we challenged immature (IMM), M0, M1, and M2 human THP-1 macrophage cells containing an Interferon Stimulated Response Element (ISRE) promoter-reporter with ATCV-1 or its Major Capsid protein (MCP) glycans. ATCV-1 infected M1 THP-1 to a greater degree than IMM, M0, or M2 THP-1. The initial high ISRE-promoter activity of M1 THP-1 was suppressed by the MCP-Glycans of ATCV-1. M0, but not IMM or M2 THP-1 produced IL-6 in response to ATCV-1 or its MCP-glycan, while high levels of IL-6 from unchallenged M1 THP-1 increased further by ATCV-1 or its MCP glycan. In contrast, ATCV-1 or its MCP-Glycan significantly reduced the high levels of IL-10 produced by M2 THP-1. Thus, antibody to ATCV-1 in ALS patients and the susceptibility of human M1 macrophages to ATCV-1 infection with boosted inflammatory cytokine and diminished anti-inflammatory cytokine production suggest that ATCV-1 may contribute to ALS motor neuron disease.
items.titleZh: ALS患者中巨噬细胞对Chlorovirus ATCV-1的反应及抗体水平升高
items.summaryZh: 这项研究在另一个ALS患者队列中再次证实，患者血清和脑脊液中针对绿藻病毒ATCV-1的抗体水平高于健康对照。体外实验显示，ATCV-1优先感染促炎型M1巨噬细胞，增强其IL-6等炎症因子产生，同时抑制抗炎型M2巨噬细胞的IL-10分泌。这些结果支持ATCV-1感染可能通过加剧神经炎症参与ALS病理过程的假说。
items.insight: 该研究为环境病毒因素参与ALS发病提供了新的证据链：从动物模型到独立患者队列的抗体验证，再到人巨噬细胞感染机制的体外实验，提示口腔微生物组中的ATCV-1可能通过调节巨噬细胞极化状态影响ALS疾病进程，值得关注其作为潜在治疗靶点或疾病修饰因素的可能性。

items.abstractZh: Acanthocystis turfacea chlorella virus 1 (ATCV-1)是一种巨型病毒，属于人类口腔微生物组的一部分。此前研究表明，ATCV-1可感染小鼠巨噬细胞，刺激炎症细胞因子产生，并加速肌萎缩侧索硬化症（ALS）模型SOD1-G93A转基因小鼠的运动神经元疾病进展。此外，与健康对照相比，ALS患者血清中针对ATCV-1的IgG1抗体水平显著升高，提示ATCV-1可能参与ALS发病。本研究使用来自不同ALS队列的血清和脑脊液，再次证实ALS患者中针对ATCV-1的抗体水平高于健康对照。为评估ATCV-1对人巨噬细胞的作用，研究者使用含有干扰素刺激反应元件（ISRE）启动子报告基因的未成熟（IMM）、M0、M1和M2人THP-1巨噬细胞，分别以ATCV-1或其主要衣壳蛋白（MCP）聚糖进行刺激。结果显示，ATCV-1对M1 THP-1的感染程度高于IMM、M0或M2 THP-1。M1 THP-1初始较高的ISRE启动子活性被ATCV-1的MCP聚糖所抑制。M0（而非IMM或M2）THP-1在ATCV-1或其MCP聚糖刺激下产生IL-6，而未受刺激的M1 THP-1本身产生的高水平IL-6在ATCV-1或其MCP聚糖作用下进一步升高。相反，ATCV-1或其MCP聚糖显著降低了M2 THP-1产生的高水平IL-10。因此，ALS患者中针对ATCV-1的抗体以及人M1巨噬细胞对ATCV-1感染的易感性（伴随炎症细胞因子增强和抗炎细胞因子减少）提示ATCV-1可能促进ALS运动神经元疾病进展。
items.frontierRationale: 该研究结合独立患者队列验证和巨噬细胞亚型特异性感染机制，为病毒-免疫互作在ALS发病中的转化价值提供了新近证据。

items.title: Multiplex Panel Detects Glial and Inflammatory Biomarker Signatures in Sporadic and C9orf72-ALS.
items.summary: CSF proteomics has emerged as a valuable strategy for identifying diagnostic and prognostic biomarkers in amyotrophic lateral sclerosis (ALS). However, the limited availability and volumes of CSF samples restrict the broader clinical application of CSF-based biomarker panels. To address this challenge, we investigated whether the novel nucleic acid-linked immuno-sandwich assay (NULISA) multiplex platform-capable of quantifying multiple neural, glial, and inflammatory markers from minimal biofluid volumes-could validate previously proposed biomarkers and identify additional candidates relevant to ALS. Using this platform, we measured a targeted panel of 131 biomarkers in cohorts of patients with C9orf72-associated ALS, sporadic ALS (sALS), and matched healthy controls. The 6 markers neurofilament heavy chain (NEFH) and neurofilament light chain (NEFL), chitinases-particularly chitotriosidase-1 (CHIT1) and chitinase-3-like protein-1 (CHI3L1), and chemokines CCL2 and CCL3 were significantly elevated in both ALS groups compared with controls. These biomarkers correlated with disease progression and demonstrated strong diagnostic performance when combined into aggregate scores, as reflected by a high area under the receiver operating characteristic curve for ALS. Notably, C9orf72-ALS patients exhibited higher levels of the oxidative stress-related markers PRDX6 and ENO2, compared with sALS patients, suggesting a genotype-specific molecular signature. Overall, our findings support the use of a multiplexed panel of diverse, inflammatory, glial, and neurodegeneration-associated biomarkers as a complementary diagnostic and prognostic tool alongside established measurements of neurofilaments. This approach may enhance biomarker robustness while minimizing CSF volume requirements, thereby improving clinical feasibility in ALS research and care.

items.summaryZh: 这项研究利用NULISA多重平台，在少量脑脊液中同时检测131种生物标志物，发现ALS患者（包括散发性与C9orf72相关）中神经丝（NEFL/NEFH）、几丁质酶（CHIT1/CHI3L1）和趋化因子（CCL2/CCL3）显著升高，且与疾病进展相关。C9orf72-ALS患者还表现出独特的氧化应激标志物（PRDX6、ENO2）升高。该面板有望成为ALS诊断和预后的补充工具，减少脑脊液用量。

items.abstractZh: 脑脊液蛋白质组学已成为识别肌萎缩侧索硬化（ALS）诊断和预后生物标志物的重要策略。然而，脑脊液样本的有限可用性和体积限制了基于脑脊液的生物标志物面板的更广泛临床应用。为应对这一挑战，我们研究了新型核酸连接免疫三明治检测（NULISA）多重平台——该平台能够从极少量生物流体中定量多种神经、胶质和炎症标志物——是否能够验证先前提出的生物标志物并识别与ALS相关的其他候选标志物。使用该平台，我们在C9orf72相关ALS、散发性ALS（sALS）和匹配的健康对照组队列中测量了131种生物标志物的靶向面板。与对照组相比，两个ALS组的6种标志物——神经丝重链（NEFH）和神经丝轻链（NEFL）、几丁质酶（特别是壳三糖苷酶-1（CHIT1）和几丁质酶-3样蛋白-1（CHI3L1））以及趋化因子CCL2和CCL3——显著升高。这些生物标志物与疾病进展相关，并在组合成综合评分时表现出强大的诊断性能，反映为ALS的高受试者工作特征曲线下面积。值得注意的是，与sALS患者相比，C9orf72-ALS患者表现出更高水平的氧化应激相关标志物PRDX6和ENO2，提示存在基因型特异性分子特征。总体而言，我们的研究结果支持使用包含多种炎症、胶质和神经退行性相关生物标志物的多重面板，作为已建立的神经丝测量的补充诊断和预后工具。这种方法可能增强生物标志物的稳健性，同时最小化脑脊液体积需求，从而提高ALS研究和护理中的临床可行性。
items.frontierRationale: 该研究采用新型NULISA多重平台，在极少量脑脊液中同时检测131种标志物，并识别出C9orf72-ALS特有的氧化应激特征，具有转化价值，可能推动ALS生物标志物检测的临床可行性。

items.title: Association of Military Branch and Rank With Amyotrophic Lateral Sclerosis Incidence Among United States Veterans.
items.summary: Military service is one of the most consistent risk factors for the development of amyotrophic lateral sclerosis (ALS), but little is known about what aspects of military service matter. Understanding the distribution of ALS risk in military personnel may help identify key risk factors. We aimed to ascertain the association of United States (US) military branch and rank with incident ALS. We conducted a longitudinal cohort study including all veterans with a Veterans Health Administration encounter from January 1, 2000, through October 1, 2024, and more than 2 years of follow-up. Incident ALS was identified through medical records. Exposures included military branch (Army, Navy, Air Force, Marine Corps, Coast Guard, or multiple branches), military rank (officer, enlisted, or both), and length of service. Risk was estimated with Cox proportional hazards models, controlled for age, adjusted for race/ethnicity, and stratified by sex. The analytic sample comprised 9,157,938 men (13,935 incident ALS cases, mean age = 56.9 years) and 784,941 women (484 cases, mean age = 42.4 at start of follow up). Among men, compared with service in the Army, service in the Air Force (hazard ratio [HR] = 1.29, 95% CI 1.23-1.35), Navy (HR = 1.15, 95% CI 1.10-1.20), and Coast Guard (HR = 1.26, 95% CI 1.06-1.50) was associated with higher rates of ALS and service in the Marines a lower rate (HR = 0.78, 95% CI 0.68-0.88). Officers had higher rates than enlisted personnel (men, HR = 1.64, 95% CI 1.53-1.74; women, HR = 1.72, 95% CI 1.31-2.27). Longer service was associated with lower rates of ALS. In age-stratified models, differences in hazard rates between Army veterans and Air Force, Navy, and Coast Guard veterans were greatest for the youngest men (17-61 years, HR range = 1.26 to 1.51) and smallest for the oldest (>75-104 years, HR range = 0.99 to 1.12). ALS rates varied considerably by branch and rank in the US military, with larger differences among younger veterans. Officers and those serving in the Air Force, Navy, or Coast Guard may incur exposure to military environments that increase risk of ALS. It is imperative to identify relevant exposures to reduce harm to service members and, potentially, civilians with similar exposures.
items.titleZh: 美国退伍军人中军种和军衔与肌萎缩侧索硬化发病率的关联
items.summaryZh: 这项大型纵向队列研究分析了美国超过990万名退伍军人的数据，发现ALS发病率与军种和军衔显著相关。空军、海军和海岸警卫队服役者风险高于陆军，而海军陆战队风险较低；军官风险约为士兵的1.6-1.7倍。值得注意的是，服役年限越长，ALS风险反而越低。军种间的风险差异在年轻退伍军人中最为明显，提示早期军事环境暴露可能对ALS风险有重要影响。
items.insight: 这项研究首次在大规模全国性队列中系统揭示了军种和军衔对ALS风险的具体影响模式，特别是军官风险显著高于士兵这一发现，挑战了以往认为体力消耗或创伤为主要风险因素的假设，提示可能存在与军官职业角色相关的特定暴露（如电磁场、化学物质、压力等），为ALS病因学研究提供了新的方向。

aiRead.limitation: 研究为观察性设计，无法确定因果关系；未纳入具体暴露信息（如具体岗位、环境暴露等）；退伍军人健康管理局数据可能未覆盖所有退伍军人；女性样本量相对较小。

items.abstractZh: 服兵役是肌萎缩侧索硬化（ALS）发病最一致的风险因素之一，但关于军事服务的哪些方面重要，目前知之甚少。了解军人中ALS风险的分布可能有助于识别关键风险因素。我们旨在确定美国军种和军衔与ALS发病的关联。我们进行了一项纵向队列研究，纳入2000年1月1日至2024年10月1日期间所有在退伍军人健康管理局有就诊记录且随访超过2年的退伍军人。通过医疗记录识别新发ALS病例。暴露因素包括军种（陆军、海军、空军、海军陆战队、海岸警卫队或多个军种）、军衔（军官、士兵或两者）以及服役年限。使用Cox比例风险模型估计风险，控制年龄，调整种族/民族，并按性别分层。分析样本包括9,157,938名男性（13,935例新发ALS病例，平均年龄56.9岁）和784,941名女性（484例病例，随访开始时平均年龄42.4岁）。在男性中，与陆军服役相比，空军（风险比[HR]=1.29，95% CI 1.23-1.35）、海军（HR=1.15，95% CI 1.10-1.20）和海岸警卫队（HR=1.26，95% CI 1.06-1.50）服役与更高的ALS发病率相关，而海军陆战队服役与较低发病率相关（HR=0.78，95% CI 0.68-0.88）。军官的发病率高于士兵（男性，HR=1.64，95% CI 1.53-1.74；女性，HR=1.72，95% CI 1.31-2.27）。较长的服役年限与较低的ALS发病率相关。在按年龄分层的模型中，陆军退伍军人与空军、海军和海岸警卫队退伍军人之间的风险差异在最年轻的男性中最大（17-61岁，HR范围=1.26至1.51），在最年长者中最小（>75-104岁，HR范围=0.99至1.12）。美国军队中ALS发病率因军种和军衔而异，年轻退伍军人中的差异更大。军官以及在空军、海军或海岸警卫队服役的人员可能暴露于增加ALS风险的军事环境中。识别相关暴露以减少对服役人员以及可能具有类似暴露的平民的伤害至关重要。
items.frontierRationale: 该研究基于2024年最新随访数据，首次在大规模队列中揭示军衔（军官vs士兵）与ALS风险的显著关联，为识别军事相关ALS暴露因素提供了全新的流行病学线索。

items.title: Association of Plasma Neurofilament Light Chain With Diagnostic Classification in a Neuromuscular Referral Cohort: A Cross-Sectional Study.
items.summary: Plasma neurofilament light chain (pNfL) is a blood-based biomarker of axonal injury elevated in several neuromuscular disorders. While previous studies have compared individual diseases with healthy controls, less is known about how pNfL performs across clinically relevant neuromuscular presentations encountered in subspecialty practice, particularly in distinguishing active from inactive neuropathies. We evaluated whether abnormal age-adjusted pNfL concentrations are associated with clinically relevant diagnostic categories and whether pNfL discriminates between active and inactive neuropathies. We conducted a cross-sectional study of patients evaluated by neuromuscular specialists at Mayo Clinic (Rochester, MN) between April 2022 and April 2024, in whom pNfL was ordered as part of routine clinical care. Diagnoses were assigned to prespecified categories by consensus review, including motor neuron disease (MND), active neuropathy, inactive neuropathy, and structural etiologies. Clinically active neuropathy was defined using prespecified, diagnosis-specific operational criteria incorporating treatment status, clinical relapse or progression, time from symptom onset, and pathologic evidence of inflammation. Abnormal pNfL was defined using previously established age-adjusted 97.5th percentile reference limits. Multinomial logistic regression evaluated associations between abnormal pNfL and diagnostic category, adjusting for neuropathy impairment score and symptom duration. Receiver operating characteristic (ROC) analyses assessed discrimination between prespecified groups. Among 306 patients (mean age 62.2 years, 41.5% female), 179 (58.5%) had MND, 28 (9.1%) active neuropathy, 75 (12.1%) inactive neuropathy, and 24 (7.8%) structural etiologies. Median pNfL concentrations differed across diagnostic groups ( p < 0.0001) and were highest in MND and active neuropathy. After adjustment, abnormal pNfL was associated with a higher relative likelihood of classification as MND (relative risk ratio [RRR] 18.47, 95% CI 8.77-38.86) and active neuropathy (RRR 7.30, 95% CI 2.50-21.34) compared with inactive neuropathies. No association was observed with structural etiologies. Discrimination between active and inactive neuropathy was moderate (area under the curve [AUC] 0.79, 95% CI 0.70-0.88), and discrimination for MND vs all other diagnoses was good (AUC 0.85, 95% CI 0.80-0.90). In this cross-sectional cohort, abnormal age-adjusted pNfL concentrations were more frequently observed in diagnostic categories characterized by clinically active axonal injury than in inactive neuropathies and structural conditions. These findings suggest a potential role for pNfL as an adjunctive tool in neuromuscular diagnostic evaluation. Interpretation is limited by the cross-sectional design and convenience sampling. This study provides Class II evidence that abnormal age-adjusted pNfL distinguishes active neuropathies from inactive neuropathies with moderate diagnostic accuracy.

items.titleZh: 血浆神经丝轻链与神经肌肉转诊队列中诊断分类的关联：一项横断面研究
items.summaryZh: 这项横断面研究分析了306名神经肌肉转诊患者的血浆NfL水平，发现年龄校正后的异常pNfL在运动神经元病（如ALS）和活动性神经病变中显著升高，而在非活动性神经病变和结构性病因中较少见。pNfL区分活动性与非活动性神经病变的准确性中等（AUC 0.79），区分MND与其他诊断的准确性良好（AUC 0.85）。研究提示pNfL可作为神经肌肉疾病诊断评估的辅助生物标志物，但需注意其横断面设计和便利抽样的局限性。

items.abstractZh: 血浆神经丝轻链（pNfL）是一种基于血液的轴突损伤生物标志物，在多种神经肌肉疾病中升高。虽然既往研究将个别疾病与健康对照进行比较，但关于pNfL在亚专科实践中遇到的临床相关神经肌肉表现中的表现，尤其是在区分活动性与非活动性神经病变方面的作用，知之甚少。我们评估了年龄校正后异常pNfL浓度是否与临床相关的诊断类别相关，以及pNfL是否能区分活动性和非活动性神经病变。我们在2022年4月至2024年4月期间，对梅奥诊所（罗切斯特，明尼苏达州）神经肌肉专科医生评估的患者进行了一项横断面研究，这些患者在常规临床护理中接受了pNfL检测。通过共识审查将诊断分配到预设类别，包括运动神经元病（MND）、活动性神经病变、非活动性神经病变和结构性病因。临床活动性神经病变使用预设的、诊断特异性的操作标准定义，包括治疗状态、临床复发或进展、症状发作时间以及炎症的病理学证据。异常pNfL使用先前建立的年龄调整的97.5百分位参考限值定义。多项逻辑回归评估了异常pNfL与诊断类别之间的关联，调整了神经病变损伤评分和症状持续时间。接受者操作特征（ROC）分析评估了预设组之间的区分能力。在306名患者中（平均年龄62.2岁，41.5%为女性），179名（58.5%）患有MND，28名（9.1%）患有活动性神经病变，75名（12.1%）患有非活动性神经病变，24名（7.8%）患有结构性病因。各诊断组的中位pNfL浓度存在差异（p < 0.0001），MND和活动性神经病变中最高。调整后，与非活动性神经病变相比，异常pNfL与MND分类的相对可能性较高（相对风险比[RRR] 18.47，95% CI 8.77-38.86）和活动性神经病变（RRR 7.30，95% CI 2.50-21.34）相关。未观察到与结构性病因的关联。活动性与非活动性神经病变之间的区分能力中等（曲线下面积[AUC] 0.79，95% CI 0.70-0.88），MND与所有其他诊断的区分能力良好（AUC 0.85，95% CI 0.80-0.90）。在这个横断面队列中，年龄校正后异常pNfL浓度在临床活动性轴突损伤特征的诊断类别中比非活动性神经病变和结构性条件更常见。这些发现提示pNfL作为神经肌肉诊断评估辅助工具的潜在作用。解释受横断面设计和便利抽样限制。本研究提供了II级证据，表明年龄校正后异常pNfL以中等诊断准确性区分活动性神经病变与非活动性神经病变。
items.frontierRationale: 该研究基于2022-2024年的临床队列，直接评估了pNfL在ALS相关诊断分类中的鉴别价值，具有高度的ALS相关性和转化潜力。

items.title: Neurology ® Journal Club: Duration of Current Statin Use and Amyotrophic Lateral Sclerosis Risk.
items.summary: This article critically appraises the study by Nakken et al., "Duration of Current Statin Use and Amyotrophic Lateral Sclerosis (ALS) Risk." Previous observational studies and Mendelian randomization studies examining statin use and ALS risk have reported mixed results. Millions of adults receive statins for cardiovascular prevention and may be concerned when neuromuscular symptoms suggestive of ALS appear. Using linked nationwide health survey and prescription data, this Norwegian population-based cohort study applied time-dependent models to evaluate statin use and subsequent ALS risk. Short-term statin use was associated with increased ALS risk, whereas long-term use was associated with lower risk. The authors interpreted this as evidence of reverse causation rather than a causal or protective effect of statins. Key strengths of the study include its large population-based design, the use of a negative control, and time-dependent Cox modeling. However, limitations inherent to observational study designs and potential residual confounding should be considered. In this article, we summarize the findings, highlight key statistical concepts, and discuss the study's major strengths and limitations.
items.titleZh: Neurology® 期刊俱乐部：当前他汀类药物使用持续时间与肌萎缩侧索硬化风险
items.summaryZh: 这项来自挪威的人群队列研究，利用全国健康调查和处方数据，评估了他汀类药物使用持续时间与 ALS 风险的关系。研究发现短期使用他汀与 ALS 风险增加相关，而长期使用与风险降低相关，但作者认为这更可能是反向因果（即早期 ALS 症状导致短期用药）而非他汀的保护作用。研究优势包括大规模人群设计、阴性对照和时间依赖模型，但观察性研究的残余混杂仍需注意。
items.insight: 该研究为 ALS 研究者提供了关于他汀类药物与 ALS 风险关系的流行病学证据，强调了反向因果的可能性，有助于理解药物暴露与 ALS 发病之间的复杂关联，并提示在解读观察性数据时需谨慎。

items.abstractZh: 本文对 Nakken 等人的研究《当前他汀类药物使用持续时间与肌萎缩侧索硬化（ALS）风险》进行了批判性评估。既往关于他汀类药物使用与 ALS 风险的观察性研究和孟德尔随机化研究报告了不一致的结果。数百万成年人因心血管预防接受他汀类药物治疗，当出现提示 ALS 的神经肌肉症状时可能感到担忧。这项基于挪威全国人群的队列研究，利用关联的全国健康调查和处方数据，采用时间依赖模型评估他汀类药物使用与后续 ALS 风险。短期他汀类药物使用与 ALS 风险增加相关，而长期使用与较低风险相关。作者将此解释为反向因果的证据，而非他汀类药物的因果或保护作用。该研究的主要优势包括其大型人群为基础的设计、使用阴性对照和时间依赖的 Cox 模型。然而，应考虑观察性研究设计固有的局限性和潜在的残余混杂。在本文中，我们总结了研究结果，强调了关键统计概念，并讨论了研究的主要优势和局限性。
items.frontierRationale: 该研究基于最新全国性数据，采用时间依赖模型和阴性对照，为 ALS 风险因素研究提供了新近的流行病学证据，具有转化价值。

items.title: Interleukin-6 trans-signalling as a selectively targetable driver of neurodegeneration.
items.summary: Interleukin-6 (IL-6) exerts protective and pathogenic effects in the central nervous system through distinct receptor-signalling modes. Classical signalling via membrane-bound IL-6 receptor (IL-6R) is often associated with homeostatic and reparative functions, whereas trans-signalling, mediated by soluble IL-6R, expands IL-6 responsiveness to gp130-expressing cells and may promote chronic inflammation. Emerging evidence implicates dysregulated IL-6 trans-signalling in amyotrophic lateral sclerosis, Alzheimer's disease, Parkinson's disease, Huntington's disease, and multiple sclerosis. Here, we review mechanisms linking IL-6 trans-signalling to immune, glial, neuronal, and vascular dysfunction in neurodegeneration. We highlight key knowledge gaps and discuss whether selective targeting of trans-signalling can limit inflammatory pathology while preserving beneficial classical IL-6 functions.
items.titleZh: 白细胞介素-6 反式信号传导作为神经退行性变中可选择性靶向的驱动因素
items.summaryZh: 这篇综述聚焦 IL-6 的两种信号模式：经典信号（膜结合受体）通常起保护作用，而反式信号（可溶性受体）可能驱动慢性炎症和神经退行性变。作者提出，选择性阻断反式信号传导可能成为 ALS 等疾病的治疗策略，同时避免影响 IL-6 的正常生理功能。文章还指出了当前研究的不足，例如反式信号在疾病中的具体细胞来源和时空调控尚不明确。
items.insight: 该综述为 ALS 研究者提供了新的治疗思路：与其全面抑制 IL-6（可能带来副作用），不如精准靶向反式信号通路，这可能更有效且更安全。文章整合了 IL-6 信号在多种神经退行性疾病中的证据，有助于推动 ALS 中炎症机制的转化研究。

aiRead.keyFinding: IL-6 反式信号传导是神经退行性变的潜在驱动因素，选择性靶向该通路可能保留经典信号的保护功能。
aiRead.limitation: 综述基于现有文献，缺乏原始实验数据；反式信号的特异性靶向在临床中尚未验证。
aiRead.watchNext: 关注后续针对 IL-6 反式信号的特异性抑制剂（如可溶性 gp130 类似物）在 ALS 动物模型和早期临床试验中的结果。

items.abstractZh: 白细胞介素-6（IL-6）通过不同的受体信号传导模式在中枢神经系统中发挥保护和致病作用。通过膜结合 IL-6 受体（IL-6R）的经典信号传导通常与稳态和修复功能相关，而由可溶性 IL-6R 介导的反式信号传导则将 IL-6 反应性扩展到表达 gp130 的细胞，并可能促进慢性炎症。新出现的证据表明，IL-6 反式信号传导失调与肌萎缩侧索硬化症、阿尔茨海默病、帕金森病、亨廷顿病和多发性硬化症有关。本文回顾了将 IL-6 反式信号传导与神经退行性变中的免疫、胶质细胞、神经元和血管功能障碍联系起来的机制。我们强调了关键的知识空白，并讨论了选择性靶向反式信号传导是否能在保留有益的经典 IL-6 功能的同时限制炎症病理。
items.frontierRationale: 该综述发表于 2026 年，系统总结了 IL-6 反式信号在 ALS 等疾病中的最新证据，并提出了选择性靶向策略，具有直接的转化价值。

items.title: Frontotemporal dementia with right temporal predominance: a clinical comparison with left-predominant FTD.
items.summary: The right-temporal variant of frontotemporal dementia (FTD) is well characterised. Whether it should be considered a distinct clinical entity, separate from other syndromes of FTD, remains an open question. The study addressed the issue through a retrospective comparison of clinical characteristics of patients with predominant atrophy in right or left anterior temporal lobe (R-ATL vs. L-ATL). Patients were identified from a clinical database, diagnosed with FTD, and reported to show temporal lobe atrophy on imaging. Fifty-one patients were selected in whom independent ratings of atrophy were greatest in right or left anterior temporal lobe. Presenting symptoms, cognitive and behavioural characteristics, neuropsychological findings, and diagnostic classification were recorded. Difficulty recognising people, impaired decision-making, perseverative preoccupations, disinhibition, and loss of empathy characterised the R-ATL group, in keeping with the previous reports. There was, however, overlap in cognitive and behavioural symptomatology in R-ATL and L-ATL, and sensitivity and specificity values were modest. Group differences diminished with disease progression. The most common clinical classification at first assessment in both groups was semantic dementia (SD), with other patients being classified as behavioural-variant FTD (bvFTD), FTD with amyotrophic lateral sclerosis or mixed FTD/SD. Not all patients with L-ATL met criteria for semantic variant primary progressive aphasia (svPPA). The data question the notion that R-ATL and L-ATL presentations are separate entities. We argue that a common diagnostic framework for the two is warranted, with classification being based on cognitive/behavioural characteristics rather than neuroradiological grounds.
items.titleZh: 右颞叶为主的额颞叶痴呆：与左颞叶为主的FTD的临床比较
items.summaryZh: 这项研究比较了右颞叶萎缩为主和左颞叶萎缩为主的FTD患者的临床特征，发现两者在症状上存在显著重叠，且随疾病进展差异减小。研究提示，右颞叶和左颞叶为主的FTD可能不应被视为完全独立的临床实体，而应基于认知和行为特征进行统一分类。
items.insight: 对于ALS研究者，这项研究提供了FTD谱系疾病的临床异质性证据，有助于理解FTD-ALS重叠综合征的表型多样性，并可能影响未来对FTD-ALS患者的诊断分层和临床试验设计。

aiRead.keyFinding: 右颞叶和左颞叶为主的FTD在认知和行为症状上重叠显著，诊断敏感性和特异性中等，且差异随疾病进展减小，不支持将两者视为完全独立的实体。
aiRead.limitation: 样本量较小（51例），且为回顾性设计，可能引入选择偏倚；影像学萎缩评级依赖主观判断。
aiRead.watchNext: 关注后续研究是否采用更大样本和纵向设计，以验证统一诊断框架的可行性，并探索FTD-ALS重叠病例的亚型分类。

items.abstractZh: 额颞叶痴呆（FTD）的右颞叶变异型已被充分描述，但它是否应被视为独立于其他FTD综合征的临床实体，仍是一个悬而未决的问题。本研究通过回顾性比较右或左前颞叶（R-ATL vs. L-ATL）萎缩为主患者的临床特征来解决这一问题。患者从临床数据库中筛选，诊断为FTD，且影像学显示颞叶萎缩。共纳入51名患者，其独立评定的萎缩程度在右或左前颞叶最为显著。记录其首发症状、认知和行为特征、神经心理学发现及诊断分类。R-ATL组表现为人物识别困难、决策受损、持续性先占观念、脱抑制和共情丧失，与既往报道一致。然而，R-ATL和L-ATL在认知和行为症状上存在重叠，敏感性和特异性值中等。组间差异随疾病进展而减小。两组在首次评估时最常见的临床分类均为语义性痴呆（SD），其他患者被分类为行为变异型FTD（bvFTD）、FTD伴肌萎缩侧索硬化或混合型FTD/SD。并非所有L-ATL患者都符合语义变异型原发性进行性失语（svPPA）的标准。数据质疑了R-ATL和L-ATL表现是独立实体的观点。作者认为，对两者采用共同的诊断框架是合理的，分类应基于认知/行为特征而非神经放射学依据。
items.frontierRationale: 该研究基于2026年最新临床数据，直接挑战了FTD亚型分类的传统观点，对ALS相关FTD的临床诊断和分类具有转化价值。

items.title: Value of ultrasound-detected fasciculations for the early diagnosis of motor neuron disease in patients with single-segment, pure lower motor neuron involvement.
items.summary: To evaluate the early diagnostic value of muscle ultrasound (US)-detected fasciculations in motor neuron disease (MND) patients presenting with single‑region, pure lower motor neuron (LMN) involvement. Prospective cohort study enrolling 60 patients with clinical LMN signs confined to one body region. All underwent standardized needle EMG and muscle US at baseline. Final diagnosis determined by follow-up. Agreement between EMG and US, and net diagnostic gain of US were analyzed. 54 MND patients (median disease duration 9 months) were analyzed. US detection rates: bulbar 38.9%-46.3%; high-grade cervical fasciculations 20.4%-37.0%. EMG-US agreement was poor to fair (kappa 0.106-0.360). US provided additional LMN evidence in EMG-negative regions in 27.8% (bulbar), 22.2% (cervical) and 9.3% (lumbosacral). Using US (≥ 2 regions with fasciculations/high-grade) as an ancillary criterion, 53.7% were diagnosed at first visit; median time to diagnosis was 5 months (range 3-8) in those otherwise missed. Muscle ultrasound is a sensitive, non-invasive complement to EMG, significantly improving early diagnosis in single-region pure LMN presentations. However, specificity estimates remain preliminary due to the limited number of non-MND controls.
items.titleZh: 超声检测肌束颤动在单节段纯下运动神经元受累患者中早期诊断运动神经元病的价值
items.summaryZh: 这项前瞻性研究显示，对于症状局限于单一身体区域、表现为纯下运动神经元受累的疑似运动神经元病患者，肌肉超声检测肌束颤动能显著提高早期诊断率。超声在肌电图阴性的区域（尤其是延髓和颈段）发现了额外的下运动神经元受累证据，使超过一半的患者在首次就诊时即可获得诊断，并将其余患者的诊断时间中位数缩短至5个月。超声与肌电图的一致性较差，提示两者互补而非替代。
items.insight: 该研究为临床实践中一个常见诊断难题——单区域纯下运动神经元受累患者的早期识别——提供了量化证据，支持将肌肉超声作为肌电图的常规补充工具，可能缩短诊断延迟并促进早期干预。

items.abstractZh: 评估肌肉超声（US）检测肌束颤动在表现为单区域、纯下运动神经元（LMN）受累的运动神经元病（MND）患者中的早期诊断价值。前瞻性队列研究，纳入60例临床LMN体征局限于一个身体区域的患者。所有患者在基线时均接受标准化针极肌电图（EMG）和肌肉超声检查。最终诊断由随访确定。分析了EMG与US之间的一致性，以及US的净诊断增益。共分析54例MND患者（中位病程9个月）。US检出率：延髓区38.9%-46.3%；高位颈段肌束颤动20.4%-37.0%。EMG-US一致性差至一般（kappa 0.106-0.360）。US在EMG阴性区域提供了额外的LMN证据：延髓区27.8%，颈段22.2%，腰骶段9.3%。使用US（≥2个区域出现肌束颤动/高等级）作为辅助标准，53.7%的患者在首次就诊时得到诊断；在其余被漏诊的患者中，中位诊断时间为5个月（范围3-8）。肌肉超声是EMG的一种敏感、无创的补充手段，显著改善了单区域纯LMN表现患者的早期诊断。然而，由于非MND对照组数量有限，特异性估计仍属初步结果。
items.frontierRationale: 该研究发表于2026年，直接针对ALS早期诊断的临床痛点，提供了肌肉超声作为无创辅助手段的量化诊断增益，具有直接的转化应用价值。

items.title: Issues in the clinical assessment and management of people living with motor neurone disease (MND): a survey of Australian healthcare professionals.
items.summary: Objective : To inform the development of the Australian MND Guideline, this study aimed to identify challenges Australian healthcare professionals (HCPs) face in the clinical assessment and management of people living with MND (plwMND) including where practice varies from evidence or is underrepresented in the literature and challenges that arise when supporting non-MND specialists. Methods : An anonymous online survey was developed on Qualtrics (Provo, UT) and distributed in July 2025 to members of the Australian MND Guideline Clinical and Content Advisory Group. Demographic data were analyzed using descriptive statistics and verbatim responses were analyzed thematically to a pre-defined framework of guideline scopes and topics. Results : Fifty HCPs, predominantly allied health professionals, completed the survey (55% response rate). HCPs reported diagnostic delays, difficulties accessing timely multidisciplinary support, and challenges coordinating care, particularly outside MND clinic catchment areas. HCPs perceived uncertainty in respiratory support, nutrition, saliva management, and psychological and cognitive care. Variations from guidance reflected gaps and inconsistencies in the evidence base, the need for individualized care, and systemic constraints including funding, workforce shortages, and inequities in access. Non-MND specialists sought guidance on prognosis, referral pathways, symptom management, and end-of-life care. Conclusion : This survey identified areas of clinical practice uncertainty and variability in the clinical assessment and management of plwMND from the perspective of Australian HCPs. These findings will inform the development of the Australian MND Guideline, including prioritization of topics and questions, and consideration of areas where expert consensus is required.

items.titleZh: 运动神经元病（MND）患者临床评估与管理中的问题：澳大利亚医疗保健专业人员调查
items.summaryZh: 这项针对澳大利亚50名医疗保健专业人员的调查发现，MND患者的临床管理存在多个痛点：诊断延迟、多学科支持获取困难、护理协调不畅（尤其在农村/偏远地区）。临床不确定性集中在呼吸支持、营养、唾液管理和心理认知护理方面。实践与指南的偏差源于证据不足、个体化需求以及资金和人力等系统性限制。非MND专科医生特别需要预后、转诊、症状管理和临终关怀方面的指导。该调查结果将直接用于指导澳大利亚MND指南的制定。
items.insight: 这项调查直接为澳大利亚MND指南的制定提供依据，揭示了临床实践中证据空白与真实世界管理需求之间的差距，对ALS研究者而言，它指明了哪些领域需要更多高质量研究来填补证据缺口，特别是呼吸支持、营养管理和心理认知护理等非运动症状领域。

items.abstractZh: 目的：为澳大利亚MND指南的制定提供信息，本研究旨在识别澳大利亚医疗保健专业人员（HCPs）在运动神经元病（MND）患者临床评估与管理中面临的挑战，包括实践与证据不一致或文献中代表性不足的领域，以及支持非MND专科医生时出现的挑战。方法：在Qualtrics（Provo, UT）上开发了一项匿名在线调查，于2025年7月分发给澳大利亚MND指南临床和内容咨询小组成员。使用描述性统计对人口统计数据进行分析，并按照预先定义的指南范围和主题框架对逐字回答进行主题分析。结果：50名HCPs（主要为专职医疗人员）完成了调查（应答率55%）。HCPs报告了诊断延迟、难以获得及时的多学科支持以及护理协调方面的挑战，尤其是在MND诊所覆盖区域之外。HCPs认为在呼吸支持、营养、唾液管理以及心理和认知护理方面存在不确定性。与指南的偏差反映了证据基础的空白和不一致、个体化护理的需求以及系统性限制，包括资金、劳动力短缺和获取服务的不平等。非MND专科医生寻求关于预后、转诊路径、症状管理和临终关怀的指导。结论：本调查从澳大利亚HCPs的角度识别了MND患者临床评估和管理中的临床实践不确定性和变异性领域。这些发现将为澳大利亚MND指南的制定提供信息，包括主题和问题的优先级排序，以及需要专家共识的领域的考虑。
items.frontierRationale: 该研究基于2025年最新调查数据，直接服务于国家级MND临床指南的制定，具有明确的转化价值，反映了当前ALS/MND临床实践中的真实挑战与证据缺口。

items.title: Enabling Functional Independence: A Scoping Review of Upper Extremity Assistive Devices for Adults With Progressive Neuromuscular Diseases.
items.summary: Assistive technology offers an important means of compensating for lost upper extremity function in adults with progressive neuromuscular diseases (NMD), enabling participation in daily activities, supporting independence, and promoting quality of life. However, the range of available technologies and the evidence supporting their use have not been comprehensively summarized. The aim of this scoping review was to identify and characterize upper extremity assistive technologies tested in adults with NMD and to summarize the current evidence regarding their functional applications and clinical outcomes. Electronic searches for published and unpublished literature were conducted using MEDLINE, Embase.com, Web of Science, Cochrane Central, and IEEE Xplore. The search strategy incorporated controlled vocabulary and free-text synonyms for the concepts of upper extremity, rehabilitation, selected progressive neurodegenerative diseases, and assistive equipment. Following title/abstract and full-text screening, studies evaluating assistive devices tested on adults with NMD during functional task performance were included. After screening 2289 articles, 27 studies met the inclusion criteria. The studies collectively demonstrate the potential benefits and diverse range of assistive devices available to support upper extremity function. These devices ranged from low-tech solutions, such as static mobile arm supports and fabricated splints, to high-tech devices, including dynamic mobile arm supports, robotic systems, exoskeletons, and brain-computer interface systems. However, most studies were feasibility or case studies that primarily demonstrated proof of concept, with limited evidence regarding long-term effectiveness, functional outcomes, or quality of life. The findings illustrate the rapidly evolving landscape of upper extremity assistive devices for adults with NMD and their potential to improve functional performance, while highlighting the need for prospective studies that assess meaningful improvements in function, participation, and quality of life. As advances in disease-modifying therapies extend survival and preserve function for individuals with NMD, interdisciplinary collaboration among engineers, clinicians, therapists, individuals with NMD, caregivers, and regulators will be essential to develop, evaluate, and implement assistive technologies that meet users' evolving needs.
items.titleZh: 实现功能独立：进行性神经肌肉疾病成人上肢辅助装置的范围综述
items.summaryZh: 这项范围综述汇总了27项研究，涵盖从静态手臂支撑到脑机接口系统的多种上肢辅助设备，用于进行性神经肌肉疾病（包括ALS）成人。设备种类丰富，但多数研究仅为可行性或案例研究，缺乏长期有效性和生活质量改善的证据。综述强调，随着疾病修饰疗法延长生存期，需要更多前瞻性研究来验证设备对功能、参与和生活质量的真实影响。
items.insight: 该综述为ALS研究者提供了上肢辅助设备领域的全景图，明确了当前证据的空白（长期效果、功能结局），并指出跨学科合作是未来开发满足患者需求设备的关键，对ALS患者功能维持和生活质量提升具有直接指导意义。

items.abstractZh: 辅助技术为进行性神经肌肉疾病（NMD）成人补偿上肢功能丧失提供了重要手段，有助于参与日常活动、支持独立性并促进生活质量。然而，现有技术的范围及其使用证据尚未得到全面总结。本范围综述旨在识别和描述在NMD成人中测试的上肢辅助技术，并总结其功能应用和临床结局的当前证据。使用MEDLINE、Embase.com、Web of Science、Cochrane Central和IEEE Xplore对已发表和未发表文献进行电子检索。检索策略结合了受控词汇和自由文本同义词，涵盖上肢、康复、选定的进行性神经退行性疾病和辅助设备等概念。经过标题/摘要和全文筛选，纳入了在功能任务执行期间对NMD成人测试辅助设备的研究。筛选2289篇文章后，27项研究符合纳入标准。这些研究共同证明了支持上肢功能的辅助设备的潜在益处和多样性。设备范围从低技术解决方案（如静态移动手臂支撑和定制夹板）到高技术设备（包括动态移动手臂支撑、机器人系统、外骨骼和脑机接口系统）。然而，大多数研究是可行性或案例研究，主要展示概念验证，关于长期有效性、功能结局或生活质量的证据有限。研究结果展示了NMD成人上肢辅助设备快速发展的格局及其改善功能表现的潜力，同时强调需要前瞻性研究来评估功能、参与和生活质量的有意义改善。随着疾病修饰疗法延长生存期并保留NMD患者的功能，工程师、临床医生、治疗师、NMD患者、照护者和监管机构之间的跨学科合作对于开发、评估和实施满足用户不断变化需求的辅助技术至关重要。
items.frontierRationale: 该综述发表于2026年，系统梳理了从低技术到脑机接口的上肢辅助设备，反映了该领域快速演变的最新进展，并强调了在疾病修饰疗法延长生存背景下评估长期功能结局的转化价值。
